_comment: The bunfig.toml twin of sca-registry-redirect: SCA (src/ + xpi/) with a committed bun.lock whose ROOT bunfig.toml sets install.registry through an escaped quoted key ("regis\u0074ry"), which Bun reads as the same key - so the file is read with a TOML parser, not searched for the word. build-registry-redirect reports it at its line (error, the value is not judged) and aborts the review late. The committed tools/bunfig.toml is deliberately left in the fixture as the negative: Bun reads its config from the directory the install runs in, which is --sca-package-root, so a config deeper in the tree is not read and not reported.
